pages.text: Craft a birdhouse $(l)Mailbox$() from 6 planks in a little house shape around a Stamp. The planks pick its wood!$(br2)Place it and give it an ID, like your name. A letter peeks out when mail arrives.
pages.title: Your Mailbox

pages.text: Craft a $(l)Letter$() (paper + feather) and right-click to write.$(br2)Press $(l)Sign$() and type your friend's mailbox ID as the title, then right-click $(l)any$() mailbox to send it. It lands in theirs right away!
pages.title: Letters

pages.text: Sending items? Place a $(l)Package$() and fill it. Right-click it with a $(l)Stamp$() and enter a mailbox ID or coordinates. An enderman carries it there!
pages.title: Packages

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Letter$(): paper + feather$(li)$(l)Stamps$(): paper + any dye$(li)$(l)Mailbox$(): 6 planks + stamp$(li)$(l)Packing Tape$(): paper + string$(li)$(l)Package$(): chest + tape, or 3 paper + tape$(li)$(l)Package Controller$(): package + paper + redstone (tracks deliveries)
pages.title: Recipes
